about: GENERATED by user-backend/devtools/spadl_reference.py from etl/contracts/spadl-action.schema.json, etl/contracts/opta-codes.json and etl/reference/spadl.py. Do not edit.
description: One SPADL action as ETL GraphQL serves it (entity spadlActions, table dbo.spadlActions). Standard SPADL (socceraction 1.5.3) columns in camelCase, converted from MA3 by etl/reference/spadl.py, plus ETL extensions. A snapshot (matchId, s) reads rows with finalSeq <= s, for s <= matchWatermarks.spadlSeq.

field_meanings.actionId: SPADL action_id: 0, 1, 2… per match in action order; stable (rows are stored only once final and never renumbered).
field_meanings.originalEventId: MA3 id (the Opta event id); null for dribbles inserted between two actions.
field_meanings.timeSeconds: Seconds since the start of the period (inserted dribbles: midway between their neighbours).
field_meanings.teamId: Contestant id of the acting team.
field_meanings.startX: Metres. SPADL frame: the home team attacks towards x = 105 in every period; away actions are mirrored.
field_meanings.typeName: SPADL action type; non_action is never stored.
field_meanings.resultName: The Opta conversion never produces yellow_card or red_card: cards stay in rawEvents/keyEvents.
field_meanings.seq: Extension: canonical seq of the source MA3 row (its eventSeq); inserted dribbles take the next action's.
field_meanings.finalSeq: Extension: canonical seq after which this row cannot change; >= seq, non-decreasing in actionId. Shots and goals: their own seq; others: usually the next one or two actions; period_end finalises the rest of its period.
field_meanings.sourceEventId: Extension: the MA3 row's sourceEventId (the canonical MatchEvent event_id).
field_meanings.sourceTypeId: Extension: Opta type of the source MA3 row (e.g. 15 attempt saved, 16 goal, 49 ball recovery).
field_meanings.clockSeconds: Extension: broadcast match clock in seconds (period 2 starts at 2700), as matchWatermarks.clockSeconds.
field_meanings.videoSeconds: Extension: match video time of the source row.
field_meanings.possessionId: Extension: provider possession sequence of the source row.
field_meanings.bodypartObserved: Extension: a qualifier names the body part; false when SPADL's default (foot, or other for keeper actions) applies.
field_meanings.startZone: Extension: zone relative to the acting team (attacking towards the opponent's goal): thirds at 35 m and 70 m, penalty areas 16.5 m deep and 40.32 m wide split out.
field_meanings.fromShotOffTarget: Extension: the source MA3 row has Opta qualifier 190 (from shot off target). On a keeper_save: the keeper touched a shot that was going wide, not a save. False for inserted dribbles.
field_meanings.defensiveBlock: Extension: the source MA3 row has Opta qualifier 94 (defensive block). On a keeper_save: an outfield player blocked the shot, not a goalkeeper save. False for inserted dribbles.

freekick_crossed: Opta 1 Pass + qualifier 1 (q1) + Free kick taken (q5)
Opta 1 Pass + Cross (q2) + Free kick taken (q5)
Opta 1 Pass + Free kick taken (q5) + qualifier 155 (q155)
Opta 2 Offside pass + qualifier 1 (q1) + Free kick taken (q5)
Opta 2 Offside pass + Cross (q2) + Free kick taken (q5)
Opta 2 Offside pass + Free kick taken (q5) + qualifier 155 (q155)
freekick_short: Opta 2 Offside pass + Free kick taken (q5)
corner_crossed: Opta 2 Offside pass + Cross (q2) + Corner taken (q6)
dribble: inserted by the converter: the same team moved the ball 3-60 m within 10 s between two actions, or a ball recovery (Opta 49) moved it

fail: Opta 52 Keeper pick up outcome fail
success: Opta 52 Keeper pick up outcome success

foot: default when no body-part qualifier (bodypartObserved false)
head: qualifier 3 (q3)
qualifier 15 (q15)
qualifier 168 (q168)
other: default for keeper actions without a qualifier

outside_spadl: The Opta conversion never produces yellow_card or red_card: cards stay in rawEvents/keyEvents.
